panels.title: Mesaje stocate in InfluxDB, pe secunda si pe tip de senzor
panels.description: Numara punctele scrise de gateway. La 50 de senzori: traffic ~60/s, vibration ~50/s, air 5/s, alert rar.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "iot_data")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "sensor_measurements" and r._field == "seq")
  |> group(columns: ["type"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 1s, fn: count, createEmpty: false)
  |> drop(columns: ["_start", "_stop"])
  |> rename(columns: {_value: "msg"})

panels.title: Mesaje care au primit dovada Merkle (doar modul anchoring)
panels.description: Numara punctele carora close_batch le-a adaugat batch_id. Daca ramane plat in timp ce panoul de sus urca, ancorarea nu tine pasul.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "iot_data")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "sensor_measurements" and r._field == "batch_id")
  |> group()
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 1s, fn: count, createEmpty: false)
  |> drop(columns: ["_start", "_stop"])
  |> rename(columns: {_value: "ancorate"})
